triples.tail_surface: Mark head and casing before disassembly to ensure proper reassembly
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸前标记泵头和泵体以确保正确重装
triples.evidence_text: Mark head and casing before disassembly to ensure proper reassembly.

triples.tail_surface: completely vented through the suction or discharge lines, or other appropriate openings or connections
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过吸入或排出管线或其他适当开口完全泄压
triples.evidence_text: That any pressure in the chamber has been completely vented through the suction or discharge lines, or other appropriate openings or connections.

triples.head_canonical_zh: 驱动装置（电机、透平、发动机等）
triples.tail_surface: “locked out” or made non-operational, so that it cannot be started while work is being done on pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 锁定或使其不可操作以防止在泵上工作时启动
triples.evidence_text: That the driving means (motor, turbine, engine, etc.) has been “locked out” or made non-operational, so that it cannot be started while work is being done on pump.

triples.tail_surface: tilt top of head back when removing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸时将泵头顶部向后倾斜
triples.evidence_text: Do not allow idler to fall from idler pin. To prevent this, tilt top of head back when removing.

triples.tail_surface: Do not use chain or cable around relief valve body to support head during removal
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸时不要用链条或缆绳环绕安全阀阀体来支撑泵头
triples.evidence_text: Do not use chain or cable around relief valve body to support head during removal.

triples.head_surface: gasket between head and jacket head plate
triples.head_canonical_zh: 泵头与夹套端盖之间的垫片
triples.tail_surface: must be totally removed. Use new gasket when assembling pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 必须完全拆除并在装配时使用新垫片
triples.evidence_text: The gasket between head and jacket head plate must be totally removed. Use new gasket when assembling pump.

triples.tail_surface: Insert a brass or plastic bar through port opening between rotor teeth or lock coupling end of shaft to keep shaft from turning
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在转子齿间或联轴器锁紧端插入黄铜或塑料棒以防止轴转动
triples.evidence_text: Insert a brass or plastic bar through port opening between rotor teeth or lock coupling end of shaft to keep shaft from turning.

triples.tail_surface: Remove packing gland nuts. Slide packing gland out of stuffing box, and remove packing and packing retainer washer
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆除填料压盖螺母，将填料压盖滑出填料箱并取出填料及填料挡圈
triples.evidence_text: Remove packing gland nuts. Slide packing gland out of stuffing box, and remove packing and packing retainer washer.

triples.tail_surface: Install packing, staggering the joints from one side of shaft to other
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装填料并使接头在轴两侧错开
triples.evidence_text: Install packing, staggering the joints from one side of shaft to other.

triples.tail_surface: Lubricate packing rings with oil, grease, or graphite to aid assembly
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用油、脂或石墨润滑填料环以辅助装配
triples.evidence_text: Lubricate packing rings with oil, grease, or graphite to aid assembly.

triples.tail_surface: Tighten nuts until packing gland is snug against packing. DO NOT OVER-TIGHTEN!
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拧紧螺母直至填料压盖贴合填料，切勿过紧
triples.evidence_text: Tighten nuts until packing gland is snug against packing. DO NOT OVER-TIGHTEN!

triples.tail_surface: Clean all parts thoroughly and examine for wear and damage
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 彻底清洁所有零件并检查磨损和损坏
triples.evidence_text: Clean all parts thoroughly and examine for wear and damage.

triples.head_surface: lipseals, bearings, bushings, and idler pin
triples.head_canonical_zh: 唇形密封、轴承、衬套和惰轮销
triples.tail_surface: Check lipseals, bearings, bushings, and idler pin and replace if necessary
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查唇形密封、轴承、衬套和惰轮销并在必要时更换
triples.evidence_text: Check lipseals, bearings, bushings, and idler pin and replace if necessary.

triples.tail_surface: Wash bearings in clean solvent. Blow out bearings with compressed air
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用清洁溶剂清洗轴承并用压缩空气吹干
triples.evidence_text: Wash bearings in clean solvent. Blow out bearings with compressed air.

triples.tail_surface: Do not allow bearings to spin; turn them slowly by hand
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 不要让轴承空转；用手缓慢转动
triples.evidence_text: Do not allow bearings to spin; turn them slowly by hand. Spinning bearings will damage bearing components.

triples.tail_surface: determined by turning outer race by hand
triples.evidence_text: Roughness can be determined by turning outer race by hand.

triples.head_surface: inner and outer races of tapered roller bearing (Q, QS sizes)
triples.head_canonical_zh: 圆锥滚子轴承内外圈（Q、QS规格）
triples.tail_surface: Do not intermix inner and outer races of tapered roller bearing (Q, QS sizes)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 不要混装圆锥滚子轴承的内外圈（Q、QS规格）
triples.evidence_text: Do not intermix inner and outer races of tapered roller bearing (Q, QS sizes)

triples.tail_surface: checked for wear or damage while mounted on bracket
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在支架上安装时检查磨损或损坏
triples.evidence_text: Casing can be checked for wear or damage while mounted on bracket.

triples.tail_surface: Inspect bracket bushing for wear and remove if damaged or worn
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查支架衬套磨损情况，若损坏或磨损则拆除
triples.evidence_text: Inspect bracket bushing for wear and remove if damaged or worn.
